message.content: {"note_claim": "UK council tax law has no provision allowing homeowners to avoid council tax by using rooms for private prayer, regardless of religion.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "It's not true that Muslims, or members of any other religion, can avoid paying council tax on domestic properties altogether if a room is set aside for prayer.", "reason": "The Full Fact page directly confirms that no such council tax exemption exists for prayer rooms, and quotes the House of Commons Library stating these claims have no basis in council tax law."}

parsed.note_claim: UK council tax law has no provision allowing homeowners to avoid council tax by using rooms for private prayer, regardless of religion.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: It's not true that Muslims, or members of any other religion, can avoid paying council tax on domestic properties altogether if a room is set aside for prayer.
parsed.reason: The Full Fact page directly confirms that no such council tax exemption exists for prayer rooms, and quotes the House of Commons Library stating these claims have no basis in council tax law.
